blurb: Audubon Amherst Golf Course offers an 18-hole course with 6,412 yards from the longest tees and a par of 71. The facility includes a driving range, three practice putting greens, a Pro Shop, and on-site food and beverage service. Golf lessons and clinics for juniors and women are available, along with event hosting and leagues.
extraNote: Tee times can be booked up to one week in advance for public, two weeks for season pass holders · Rain checks issued for weather interruptions; refunds for cancellations more than 24 hours in advance · No outside food or beverages allowed; must purchase on site · Clubhouse at 500 Maple Rd, Buffalo, NY 14221
